privileged_info_for_vlm: The required payroll master data includes: Currencies (JPY, BRL, INR), Pay Frequencies (Semi-Monthly, Quarterly), and Prefixes (Dr., Sra., Sri). The Department must be 'International Programs'. Job Titles must be 'Country Director' and 'Regional Coordinator'. Two employees must be registered: Yuki Tanaka (EMP021, Country Director) and Fernanda Costa (EMP022, Regional Coordinator). Both must be in the 'International Programs' department.
